name: Collectors Corner
summary: Collectors Corner is Meadview's charming gift shop offering arts and crafts, antiques, and collectibles, with hundreds of items priced at $20 or less including local artisan works. The shop hosts free Saturday parking lot sales and provides community services like knife sharpening, serving as a beloved gathering place in this remote Arizona desert town.
demographics: Collectors Corner serves the rural community of Meadview, Arizona, attracting residents and visitors to this remote desert area near Lake Mead. The primary customer base consists of local residents, retirees, and outdoor enthusiasts who appreciate unique collectibles, handmade crafts, and practical services. The trade area draws from a small population with modest income levels who value community-oriented shopping experiences and locally-made artisan goods. Visitors tend to be older adults and families seeking one-of-a-kind items, antiques, and personalized services like knife sharpening that aren't available in larger retail chains.
description: Collectors Corner is Meadview's distinctive gift shop and community gathering place, specializing in arts and crafts, antiques, and unique collectors' items. Located at 30125 Escalante Boulevard in the remote desert community of Meadview, Arizona, this locally-owned establishment has become a beloved destination for residents and visitors seeking handmade treasures and personalized service. The shop features hundreds of gifts priced at $20 or less, including beautiful works by local artists such as Kay Martin's penny bottles, vases, and handmade greeting cards. Beyond retail offerings, Collectors Corner hosts popular Saturday parking lot sales where community members can set up tables, trucks, or trailers to sell their own items with no vendor fees, fostering a vibrant marketplace atmosphere. The store also provides practical services including knife and ax sharpening, and features seasonal displays such as their extensive Christmas room with hundreds of decorations and accessories, making it a year-round destination for both practical needs and special finds.
